name: miadi-session-observability
description: Session capture for Miadi hosts, installed once per host instead of hand-wired into settings.json. Every Claude Code event is written under <root>/<session_id>/ exactly as /opt/binscripts/hooks/claude_hooks writes it, so the token counter, the /token-usage page and the session observers keep working. Every file a tool call creates, changes or moves, by Bash, an MCP server, Write or Edit, is copied to written/ with a line naming the call, and every Artifact page, GitHub issue, comment or pull request, commit, push and npm release is listed in _claude_publications.jsonl with the prompt that produced it. Every /btw side question is listed in _claude_btw.jsonl, and a forked one with the fork's answer, what the person sent it and its replies. Every session start, end and rename also writes a binding line: the session id, the tmux pane it runs in (session:window.pane), its command line, its name history and its team. The session-continuity skill carries the T1 practice: binding, tmux save and restore, tide bringing agents back, and rebuilding what each pane held after a crash. At each Stop, the uncommitted files the session did not write are listed, and a reply that counts them as its own work is stopped once.
